summary.en: Formal writing and careful speech use more precise linkers than _but_, _so_ and _also_. For **contrast** use _nevertheless_ or _nonetheless_; for **result** use _consequently_ or _as a result_; for **addition** use _furthermore_ or _moreover_. _Thereby_ + -ing shows a result in the same clause, while _notwithstanding_ and _in light of_ are followed by a noun. Most linkers start a new sentence (or follow a semicolon) and take a comma afterwards. They are a strong choice in the formal email of Writing part 4, but they sound stiff in casual talk.
summary.es: Son los equivalentes formales de but, so y also. Casi todos empiezan frase (o van tras punto y coma) y llevan coma después.

form: Contrast: **Nevertheless, / Nonetheless, / However,** + clause (new sentence or after a semicolon)
Result: **Consequently, / As a result, / Therefore, / Thus** + clause
Result in the same clause: clause, **thereby** + -ing (_thereby reducing costs_)
**Notwithstanding** + noun (= in spite of); can follow the noun: _the delays notwithstanding_
**In light of / In view of** + noun, or **in light of the fact that** + clause (= considering)
Punctuation: full stop or semicolon before the linker, comma after it; never a comma alone to join two clauses

uses.text: **Contrasting a problem with a positive point in a formal email**: _The room was small. Nevertheless, the staff were exceptionally helpful._
**Explaining consequences clearly**: _Several trains were cancelled. Consequently, many commuters arrived late._
**Building an argument point by point**: _The scheme is affordable; furthermore, it is easy to maintain._
**Justifying a decision**: _In light of the recent complaints, the council has decided to review its policy._

mistakes.wrong: The service was slow, nevertheless the food was excellent.
mistakes.right: The service was slow. Nevertheless, the food was excellent.

why.en: Nevertheless is not a conjunction: it needs a full stop or semicolon before it and a comma after it.
why.es: No une dos frases solo con coma; antes va punto o punto y coma.

mistakes.wrong: The company reduced its prices, thereby to attract more customers.
mistakes.right: The company reduced its prices, thereby attracting more customers.

why.en: Thereby is followed by an -ing form.
why.es: Después de thereby va el gerundio (-ing).

mistakes.wrong: In light of that the figures fell, we changed our plans.
mistakes.right: In light of the fall in the figures, we changed our plans.

why.en: In light of is followed by a noun phrase; for a clause use in light of the fact that.
why.es: Tras in light of va un nombre, no un verbo conjugado.

examples.en: The tickets were expensive; nevertheless, the show was well worth the price.
The flat is small. Nonetheless, its location makes it very attractive.
examples.es: El piso es pequeño. Aun así, su ubicación lo hace muy atractivo.

examples.en: Several trains were cancelled. Consequently, many commuters arrived late.
The factory installed solar panels, thereby cutting its energy bills by a third.
The proposal is sound; furthermore, it is cheaper than the alternative.
Furthermore, I would be grateful if you could confirm the date in writing.
examples.es: Además, le agradecería que confirmara la fecha por escrito.

examples.en: Notwithstanding the delays, the project was completed on schedule.
In light of the recent complaints, the council has decided to review its policy.
examples.es: A la vista de las quejas recientes, el ayuntamiento ha decidido revisar su política.

examples.en: In view of the weather forecast, we regret to inform you that the event is cancelled.
The results were disappointing. Moreover, the cost of the trial was far higher than expected.

practice.prompt: The tickets were expensive; ___, the show was well worth the price.

explanation.en: Expensive tickets and a worthwhile show are in contrast, so use nevertheless.

practice.prompt: The factory installed solar panels, ___ its energy bills by a third.

explanation.en: Thereby is followed by an -ing form.

practice.prompt: ___ the recent complaints, the council has decided to review its policy.

explanation.en: In light of + noun means considering something that has happened.

practice.prompt: Several trains were cancelled. ___, many commuters arrived late.

explanation.en: Late arrival is the result of the cancellations: consequently. Notwithstanding needs a noun.

practice.prompt: The proposal is sound; ___, it is cheaper than the alternative.

explanation.en: A second advantage is added, so use furthermore.

practice.prompt: ___ the delays, the project was completed on schedule.

explanation.en: Notwithstanding + noun means in spite of.
